final_message: Aligned the distributed roster template with GPT-6 and normal/expert tiers: luna (gpt-6-luna) and sol (gpt-6.1-sol) for codex, opus as the claude expert, and codex-expert-* / claude-expert-* aliases. Init routing now sends hard to the expert aliases and medium/easy/reporter to the normal aliases (unchanged for providers without an expert tier). Codex orch scripts are orch:sol and orch:luna, and orch:terra is no longer created. Updated tests, provider READMEs, exec-config-guide, command-reference, orchestrator-operation-guide, CHANGELOG [Unreleased], and the ticket's 対応結果 section. The repo's protected .specdojo/agent-members.yaml and package.json are unchanged; the proposed changes are in the ticket.
